head: Volumes workout log app: track sets and progressive overload
dek: Volumes is a new strength training log for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch that records weight, reps and rest for each set and shows your last session next to it. It's free, with a one-time 2.99 dollar Pro unlock instead of a subscription.
details: It has more than 300 exercises, ready-made programmes and custom routines with supersets, and tracks personal records and estimated one-rep max. The free version allows up to 5 routines, 1 folder and 5 custom exercises; Pro removes those limits and adds more statistics and widgets. It works with Apple Health and syncs through iCloud. It needs iOS, iPadOS or watchOS 26; Apple Intelligence is optional and only used for summaries. It's made by David White and came out on the App Store on 14 October.
where: iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch (version 26 or later), App Store
means: If you log your gym sessions and don't want another subscription, this one covers the basics free and costs 2.99 dollars once for the rest.
todo: Try the free version first; it covers logging, rest timers and progress, and buy Pro only if you need more than 5 routines.
